name: Pars Host Addons
author: Pars Host Developer Team

sections.description:
This plugin is programmed to significantly enhance your website’s load speed, ensuring a seamless and faster user experience. Say goodbye to slow loading times


Please Note that this plugin;
* Currently supports Compress CSS and Compress JavaScript features.

Features

  1. Remove HTML comments.
  2. Remove CSS comments.
  3. Remove JS comments.
  4. Enable Lazy load for images and iframes.
  5. Supports Compressing CSS and JavaScript.
  6. Supports merging CSS and JavaScript files.

How to use

  1. After installing and activating the pars-host plugin in your WordPress website.
  2. Navigate to setting page of plugin.
  3. select the features you want to enable.

External Services

Google Translate API

This plugin uses Google Translate API to automatically translate specific text elements on your website.

  • Data sent: Text strings entered by the user in the plugin’s settings.
  • When data is sent: Data is sent to the API endpoint whenever a translation is requested.
  • Purpose: To provide automatic translation of text to the desired language.
  • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy

Credits

Pars host Addons WordPress Plugin is distributed under the terms of the GNU GPL.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin, unzip it and move the unzipped folder to the “wp-content/plugins” directory in your WordPress installation.
  2. In your admin panel, go to Plugins and you’ll find 360 Video in the plugins section.
  3. Click on the ‘Activate’ button to use your new plugin right away.
  4. PS: Remember to click the Enable auto-updates link for this plugin so that you don’t miss cool new features as they come in.
